skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Royal Guardswoman
skins.content: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Royal Guardswoman. Bagpipe's uniform as a new cadet at the military academy, doubling as formal wear. Training in formal wear was yet another duty of a royal guardsman cadet.
skins.quote: The young lady always seems to be staring off in a daze these days. Not because she's surrounded by unfamiliar people, but rather she's secretly worried that she put on her uniform in the wrong order.

skins.name: Echo of Bagpipes
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Echo of Bagpipes. Clothes Bagpipe wears when she heads home. No need for any fancy accessories. A simple dress and a bright smile are enough to charm even the critters frolicking by her side.
skins.quote: The life Bagpipe dreams of is simple. After a productive day of farmwork, she picks up the satisfaction of a hard day's work and her hopes for a bumper crop before walking home under the setting sun, accompanied by the distant sound of bagpipes. It will come true. She believes it with all her heart.

skins.name: Queen, No.1
skins.content: Whistlewind Series Race Queen Core Line/Queen, No.1. In full race queen form, sporting a Raythean-sponsored Piledriver Spear, Bagpipe carries herself tall and brings the spectators' cheers non-stop.
skins.quote: But the racers were scared of Bagpipe, because on the off-chance of a crash, they'd be the only ones injured. Luckily, that was another reason the organizers asked her to be the flag-bearer.
